notes: Encoded only from the Mortex page. Page lists Summit as a sister/similar brand but states no shared serial system, so no reuse is claimed. Character counting verified: the page states month = 2nd-3rd characters, day = 4th-5th, year = 6th-7th; the page example S0121030140 decodes under character counting as month 01, day 21, year 03 (2003). Digit-only counting is falsified for this example (it would give month 12, year 30, which cannot resolve under the 1960 floor). Day is stated on the page but the schema has no day field, so it is not encoded.

styles.era: 11-character serials: 1 letter followed by 10 numerical digits
styles.notes: Page example serial. Positions are 1-based characters on the page (month 2nd-3rd, year 6th-7th), converted to 0-based half-open [1,3] and [5,7].
